name: love_light
description: Adopted from an original hand lettered work, Love Light is an adaptation of another font. Its heart embellishments add a bit of romantic fantasy to this beautiful calligraphic script. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/love-light .
